biography:
Character Name: Orion 'Orky' McAllister

Backstory:

Orion 'Orky' McAllister was born in one of the many asteroid colonies that dot the cosmos. The colony, aptly 
named Rockville, is home to his family and countless other families who make their living off the harsh, 
unforgiving environment of space itself.

Growing up in an asteroid colony comes with its challenges. Life is hard, and survival relies heavily on 
individualism, as well as the ability to work as a team. Orky learned this early on from his parents, both 
skilled engineers responsible for maintaining the life support systems that kept Rockville thriving. His 
father was also a small-time entrepreneur who dabbled in various mining operations throughout the asteroid 
belt, often bringing back valuable minerals and metals for their community.

As Orion grew older, he became increasingly fascinated by the stories of his father's adventures in deep 
space mining. He spent countless hours listening to tales of daring exploits on distant asteroids and 
marveling at the unique equipment his father brought back from these expeditions. This fascination eventually 
led Orky to pursue a career as a deep space miner himself.

However, he knew that making it in this field would be tough; not just anyone could become a successful deep 
space miner. The best miners possess a mix of technical knowledge, physical prowess, and mental fortitude. 
They must also understand the value of teamwork, as mining operations often involve working alongside other 
skilled individuals to extract valuable resources from asteroids.

Orky spent years honing his skills, starting by learning the basics of engineering, geology, and 
astrophysics. He joined a local mining group in Rockville, where he worked under more experienced miners who 
taught him the ins and outs of their trade. With each successful mission, Orky gained confidence and slowly 
built up his reputation as a reliable and skilled deep space miner.

His big break came when he was recruited by a prominent mining corporation that sought to explore new 
asteroid fields. The pay was good, but more importantly, it allowed him to travel across the cosmos and 
experience life beyond Rockville. Eventually, he became one of the top miners in his company, earning respect 
from both his peers and superiors.

Now, Orion 'Orky' McAllister is a well-known figure within the deep space mining community. He's known for 
his exceptional skills as a miner and his ability to work seamlessly with others. As he continues his journey 
through the cosmos, Orky remains committed to uncovering valuable resources while exploring the unknown 
reaches of space.
